steps.text: The sample data from the volcano monitoring station has been retrieved. Please look over it.

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Just tell me the results.
Those people over there said that the sample's temperature has not yet exceeded the highest on record for this year.
It's also not quite at the levels of the peaks from the past three years. The state of steam emissions is normal as well.
So...

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: So?
So, the station concludes that nothing abnormal will happen with the volcano, and your request for announcement has been denied once again. The mayor also...

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: You've got to be kidding me!!

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Although my methods may be a bit simple, I'm sure that there's something amiss about this sample here.

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: The volcano was already in a precarious state last year!

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: But they didn't even send a warning or make a news report! Nothing at all!!
Miss Ceylon, p-please calm down.
If the monitoring station says that there's no abnormality, nobody will trust us no matter what we do.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Can we really rely on the monitoring station's data?
To be honest, Siesta's City Council doesn't pay much attention to this. Perhaps something is wrong with the detector.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That would mean that the fact that the volcano has become abnormal is being covered up.
So, what are you going to do next?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I can't explain the current phenomenon based upon what I know. If we can't get an accurate report from those in charge, we'll have to turn to an outside organization.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So far, things are stable here and we still have time. Would we be able to find some professionals among the tourists here if we took the time?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Even though we can't expect to find the right people, nor can we expect them to reach the correct conclusion, this is our last chance...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The tourists have already begun to pour into Siesta.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: After all, the Obsidian Festival is about to begin. If we don't act now, it'll soon be too late.
10:10 A.M. \ Clear
Siesta

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Dear tourists, welcome to Siesta, home of the annual Obsidian Festival.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Thank you for choosing Siesta as your vacation getaway. You won't be disappointed!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Here, scorching heat is turned into sizzling passion, freeing you from the stress and exhaustion of daily life. Immerse yourself in the charms that Siesta City has to offer!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: This year, there's more to Siesta than just our sunny beaches and dazzling azure waters. Don't you forget about the great Obsidian Festival!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Over the next two weeks, there will be delicious food, fun activities around the clock, and last but not least, the greatest music festival ever!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: We've invited the hottest names from all over the musical world as our special guests, to bring you an exciting music festival you won't forget!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: During the festival, we've opened up various facilities and activities to the public, free of charge, so play to your heart's content!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: In Civic Square, the Rock Party and the unlimited supply of local beer are the stars of the show!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Cut loose, and lose yourself to the rhythm!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Looking for something more leisurely? The jazz paradise is located just on the square of Herman Hotel on Second Avenue.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: No rules, and no limits. As long as you want to be here, we want you here as well!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: The Garrison Amusement Park is open 24/7 during the festival, and boasts the biggest stage in the city.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Other than the regularly scheduled shows, we'll also have some special guest appearances. If you're a fan of rap, you're not going to want to miss out!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: In addition, there will be plenty of shows and activities throughout the city for you to enjoy.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Please ask the staff as well as the guards for a map of the festival.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: We've marked the event locations as well as their times to make it easier for you to plan in advance.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: But while you're enjoying the merriment, make sure to pay attention to the weather.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Today's temperature is 96.8° F, the highest recorded this summer. Please avoid staying in the sun too long to prevent sunburn and heatstroke.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Thank you, and have a great time!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Siesta really is a prime tourist city. The atmosphere here is filled with excitement.

options: I didn't expect it to be this lively here.
They've been holding one large event after another.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Neither did I!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: None of us expected it to be such a spectacular place. We originally thought it was just another normal coastal city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks for the recommendation, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...I'm not interested in that place. Just go there yourselves.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait for me! I wanna come too!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Stop right there. You're not allowed to go since you're still recovering.

options: I don't mind a place like this.
Her recommendations are definitely spot on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I'm happy as long as you're enjoying it here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've been through too much recently. You deserve a break.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A lot of our fellow Operators have come with us, so let's all take this opportunity to relax.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Doctor, look! Someone's playing the piano in public.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Look, there are guitarists over there, as well as violinists. Wow, even dancers too...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It reminds me of when I used to practice the violin every day.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The streets give off a totally different vibe than the beach.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is my first time seeing so many performers in one place, it makes me want to join them.

options: You brought your violin, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No no, that's not what I meant. I'm not really going to join them!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If I wanted to get back to the level I was at before, I'd have to start practicing again.

options: But I don't think those guys are any better than you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Th-that's not true!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, I'm still happy to hear you say that, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hey, Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ah, Doctor! Amiya! Good morning, are you two also headed to Second Avenue?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good morning, Sora. I didn't know you were a fan of jazz as well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I thought you would've preferred pop music more.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: When it comes to music, I'm an expert in all the genres!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...Actually, I wanted to check out some other places, but the show near the hotel last night was way too loud. I couldn't sleep without earplugs.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Even though it's great to be able to listen to music throughout the day, anything will get on your nerves if it's keeping you up at night.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Because the others got a bit too crazy last night, all I can do is take a little breather around here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's a music festival after all, that just proves how lively things are here.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ahaha, guess so. A few of us have never seen the ocean before.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: For example, Ifrit rushed out this morning yelling something like 'Here I come, ocean!!' We haven't seen her ever since.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha, that's just like her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Technically, this ocean is really just a huge lake...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: As long as there's water and a beach, it's enough of an ocean for me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'll be resting here until noon. After that, even a volcanic eruption can't stop me from having the time of my life!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha, that certainly is your style. All right, I'll see you around then.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: All righty~ Amiya, Doctor, have a good time as well!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: It is now 11 o'clock! Everyone, did you have a fabulous morning?

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Let's first enjoy a cozy Siestan brunch as the merriment of the afternoon approaches us.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Today, a special guest will be joining us. Let's welcome Mister Cronin, Assistant to the Mayor of Siesta and Catastrophe Messenger. Mister Cronin, why don't you tell us a bit more about Siesta and its volcano?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Welcome to Siesta City, my friends.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Siesta is home to lush mountains and clear waters, sunny skies and refreshing breezes, and the most passionate people in the world.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Due to the rare and perfect natural environment that we've been gifted, Siesta is committed to becoming the best tourist hotspot and bringing you an unforgettable summer getaway.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: On this subject, let's talk about the Siesta Volcano. Many tourists who are unfamiliar with volcanoes may have questions about this. Care to explain it to our listeners?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Gladly. First, there's nothing to be worried about. Unlike what some people may think, the Siesta Volcano is our friend, not something filled with mysteries and dangers.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I can guarantee this as a Catastrophe Messenger, so please rest assured.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: As you may already know, Siesta's development owes greatly to the Siesta Volcano.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Some of you may remember the Catastrophe that almost hit Siesta a number of years back. But because of the volcano's protection, Siesta was totally unaffected.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Speaking of which, Siesta has another special feature - obsidian.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Obsidian is believed to have the ability to suppress Oripathy, so it has become increasingly popular in recent years.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: That's right. The small number of Infected in Siesta is the best proof of that.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: You may have heard rumors or even scientific 'theories' from outside, but the reality within Siesta is the best evidence.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Unfortunately, obsidian mining has been banned by the government in order to protect the volcano's habitat.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Nevertheless, the trade of existing obsidian products is legal, so if you're interested in these products, please head over to the market.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: During the festival, shopping guides as well as souvenir stalls will be scattered throughout the city, so feel free to take your pick!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: The volcano has brought Siesta a precious gift, and it is our wish to pass this gift onto all of you. We hope that you will all enjoy the festival.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Thank you very much, Mister Cronin. We will see you later.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Obsidian can keep Oripathy at bay? I've never heard about that before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that Catastrophe Messenger... the way he was dismissing science made me a bit uncomfortable...

options: Wouldn't it be great if Oripathy could be cured so easily?
Tourist cities always have some way to make a quick buck.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In remote places like this, many people still do not know about Originium or Catastrophes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't know if that's a blessing or a curse.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Of course ignorance is a curse!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Skyfire, Provence! Good morning!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Morning, Amiya. Doctor.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: What a coincidence to run into you guys here. Getting ready to hit the beach?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're just looking around. What about you two?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: We're going to take a look around the base of the volcano.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The base of the volcano? Let me check the map.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's no mark on it. Is there some special activity going on there?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No, no. Skyfire just suddenly felt like taking a field trip.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: And I'm a Catastrophe Messenger, as you know. Taking a quick survey of the land when I get to a new place has just become a habit of mine.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: As a researcher, I'm curious about the ecosystem of the volcano. We rarely get the chance to get up close and personal with a volcano, after all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's some serious dedication, to be doing this during your vacation, Skyfire.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Eheh. Of course. For me, that's what a vacation is.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: All right then, we have to get going. Bye!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then, we should get going as well, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The largest beach in Siesta is just ahead of us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: One Mango Martini Smoothie please.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Okay. Here you go, a Mango Martini Smoothie.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Two double-scoops of Strawberry Tequila Ice Cream please.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Here you are! Two double-scoops of Strawberry Tequila Ice Cream, coming right up! And, you get a free waffle!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Gummy~

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, Amiya! And the Doctor as well. Good to see you~

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Gummy, how'd you end up running a stall here?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: There's an entire food court by the beach. The sponsor gave the chance for tourists to show off their cooking skills.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Given an opportunity like this, I naturally had to promote some of Ursus's local favorites!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: However, there are way too many tourists here, and I'm getting a bit overwhelmed.

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Hey Miss, I'd like three cups of Fermented Bubble Tea with Pudding.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Coming right up!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh right, Doctor, can I borrow Amiya for a bit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If Amiya is helping me out, I'll be just fine.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: After we're done here, I'll take her to watch the show on the beach at night!

options: You should go, Amiya.
Don't stress her out.
Can't I also help out?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm... all right then.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, call me if you need anything, okay?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hmm, you know what Gummy thinks? Amiya's stressed out from always following you around, Doctor.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: When she's with you, she never thinks about herself, which isn't good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It, it's not like that...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm not buying it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Besides, Doctor, you're going to scare away all my customers, all wrapped up like a mummy. Amiya is way cuter than you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Th-that's not true... But, Doctor, I'll stay here and help Gummy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: So, Amiya, let me teach you how to use this machine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ah, no, you gotta change your outfit first. Hurry, over here, let me get you into something a bit easier to move around in!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Doctor, you make sure to enjoy yourself as well! Buh bye!

options: Amiya should spend more time with her peers.
(Guess I'll go take a look the beachside open-air hotel by myself.)
Maybe I really should change into something a bit more summery...

steps.name: Male Tourist A
steps.text: Hey, did you hear that? There was another fight at First Avenue last night.

steps.name: Male Tourist B
steps.text: No, I live on Fifth. I reckon it was another fight between fans?

steps.name: Male Tourist A
steps.text: Yeah. Jeez, talk about crazy. The way those guys were going at it, you'd think they killed the other guy's parents or something.

steps.name: Male Tourist B
steps.text: Peace is best, after all.

steps.name: Male Tourist A
steps.text: ...So, why don't you take off that outfit of yours already? ！

steps.name: Male Tourist A
steps.text: It's not every day we get to go on vacation, so why are you all wrapped up like that?

steps.name: Female Tourist A
steps.text: Hey, were you not going to come tonight? Join us!

steps.name: Female Tourist C
steps.text: ...Don't tell me you're going dancing again tonight.

steps.name: Female Tourist A
steps.text: Of course we're going. We came here to dance!

steps.name: Female Tourist C
steps.text: Give me a break, just go by yourselves then. I can barely feel my feet from following you guys the last three nights...

steps.name: Female Tourist A
steps.text: Come on, it's still early! Give it a few more tries, and you'll get used to it!

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Hello, whiskey for two.
Well well, with the way you're dressed, you look a bit unusual for a tourist...

options: ...I'm a bit scared of sun exposure.

steps.text: Even so, you came out all the way to the beach? What a weirdo.
...Ah, I suppose I'm one to talk though.
Sorry about that, let me put that one on my tab.

options: (Weren't the drinks supposed to be free?!)

steps.text: So, what do you think about this budding city?
I'm quite fond of her, you see. Youthful, but maturing well.

options: Are you from here?

steps.text: Though I wasn't born here, this place is my home now.
And I'm willing to pay a lot in order to protect it.
No matter where people are from, they all hold the same love for their family, right?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Boss, Mister Cronin is looking for you.
...I know.
I still have work to do. I'll be off then, stranger.
I hope that you too can fall in love with this city.

options: What a weird person.
What a friendly person.
What a good-looking person.
I have a call?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hey, Doctor, can you hear me?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Is there anyone by you? I have something very serious to report!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's something that may influence whether this city lives or dies...
